dialogue.speaker: Quest Giver
dialogue.text: Hello player! I have a quest for you.

dialogue.speaker: Quest Giver
dialogue.text: Defeat 5 slimes in the Eastern Fields and return to me for your reward!

dialogue.speaker: Quest Giver
dialogue.text: Excellent! Come back when you've defeated 5 slimes.

dialogue.speaker: Quest Giver
dialogue.text: No problem. Come back if you change your mind.
